apple.native_depth.definition: max native recorded overlap over apple/right-hand contact points; backend-specific contact construction
apple.native_depth.approximation: Native contacts and SDF discretization; not a common reference-surface distance
apple.native_depth.description_zh: 苹果与右手原生接触点的重叠最大值；引擎接触定义与 SDF 离散各异，不是全表面精度

apple.wrist_translation.definition: max norm of wrist-frame apple position minus first held position
apple.wrist_translation.approximation: Object pose drift; no persistent contact-material correspondence
apple.wrist_translation.description_zh: 保持期苹果在腕部坐标系的位置相对首帧最大位移；不是材料点滑移

apple.wrist_rotation.definition: max relative orientation geodesic angle from first held pose
apple.wrist_rotation.approximation: Object rotation; distinct from translation and rolling/sliding classification
apple.wrist_rotation.description_zh: 保持期相对首帧姿态的最大旋转角；不判定滚动或滑动

apple.clearance.definition: minimum recorded apple lowest-point height above tabletop
apple.clearance.approximation: Uses the recorded geometry-based clearance approximation
apple.clearance.description_zh: 保持期苹果最低点相对桌面最小高度；沿用记录中的几何近似

apple.support.definition: mean total hand contact force z / (mass*9.81)
apple.support.approximation: Net measured hand force, not commanded force or per-contact normal load
apple.support.description_zh: 保持期手部总接触力竖直分量均值除以重力；不是指令力或法向夹紧力

apple.momentum.definition: max norm(total force - gravity - mass*delta_velocity/dt) / weight
apple.momentum.approximation: Step-end force/velocity epoch in the frozen native log; not energy conservation
apple.momentum.description_zh: 全程逐步力与速度增量的动量残差最大值除以重力；不是能量守恒误差

cloth.ground_depth.window: every recorded physics state, initial included
cloth.ground_depth.approximation: Plane reference; prescribed collision radius, not measured cloth thickness
cloth.ground_depth.description_zh: 相对地平面的最大顶点侵入，包含设定碰撞半径；不等于实测布厚

cloth.sphere_depth.window: every recorded physics state, initial included
cloth.sphere_depth.definition: max(0, sphere_radius + collision_radius - closest triangle-interior distance)
cloth.sphere_depth.approximation: Triangle interiors and declared sphere, not native contact depth
cloth.sphere_depth.description_zh: 三角形内部到球心最近距离与球半径加碰撞半径之差的正部最大值

cloth.edge_strain.window: every recorded physics state, initial included
cloth.edge_strain.approximation: Edge strain only; not continuum stress or material calibration
cloth.edge_strain.description_zh: 相对静止边长的绝对应变最大值；不是连续介质应力或材料标定

cloth.pin_error.frame: world relative to fixed rest vertices
cloth.pin_error.window: every recorded physics state, initial included
cloth.pin_error.approximation: Prescribed boundary condition; not robot grasp quality
cloth.pin_error.description_zh: 固定顶点相对初始位置的最大位移；用于边界条件检查

cloth.final_tip_sag.definition: mean(rest_z - final_z) over declared tip vertices
cloth.final_tip_sag.approximation: Signed displacement; positive downwards; not measured material error
cloth.final_tip_sag.description_zh: 末帧自由端相对静止高度的平均下垂，向下为正；不是实测误差

cloth.crossing_pairs.definition: maximum intersecting nonadjacent triangle pairs across audited frames
cloth.crossing_pairs.approximation: Shared-vertex pairs excluded; no thickness overlap or continuous-time guarantee
cloth.crossing_pairs.description_zh: 抽样帧内非相邻三角形交叉对数最大值；排除共享顶点，不保证厚度或帧间无交叉

robot_cloth.table_depth.definition: max interior depth over zero-thickness triangle interiors in table box union
robot_cloth.table_depth.approximation: LP diagnostic; capped by half 6mm table thickness, not vertical/native penetration; no new pass threshold
robot_cloth.table_depth.description_zh: 桌体盒并集内零厚度三角形的最大内部深度；上界为桌厚一半，不是竖直或原生穿透，不新设通过阈值

robot_cloth.intrusion_frames.definition: number of frames with interior depth > numerical zero 1e-8 m
robot_cloth.intrusion_frames.approximation: Observed frame count, not continuous duration or a new physical tolerance
robot_cloth.intrusion_frames.description_zh: 超过数值零容差 1e-8 m 的侵入帧数；不是连续时间或新增物理容差

robot_cloth.anchor_error.frame: material point versus moving grasp anchor
robot_cloth.anchor_error.window: 100 Hz trace samples in [2, hold_end); hold_end from summary.schedule_s
robot_cloth.anchor_error.definition: max norm of selected material-point position minus kinematic anchor
robot_cloth.anchor_error.approximation: Includes normal separation, deformation and tangential motion; not accumulated slip
robot_cloth.anchor_error.description_zh: 选定材料点相对运动学锚点的最大距离，混合分离、形变与切向运动；不是累计滑移

robot_cloth.lift.window: 100 Hz trace samples in [2, hold_end); hold_end from summary.schedule_s
robot_cloth.lift.definition: maximum selected material-point z minus planned material-point initial z
robot_cloth.lift.approximation: One selected material point, not minimum whole-cloth clearance
robot_cloth.lift.description_zh: 保持窗口中选定材料点相对计划初始点的最大抬升；不是末帧值或整布最小离桌高度

plane.box_depth.window: every recorded physics state, initial included
plane.box_depth.approximation: Analytical box-plane geometry; separate from native soft-contact distance
plane.box_depth.description_zh: 变换后盒顶点相对 z=0 平面的最大侵入；独立解析几何，不是原生软接触距离

cylinder.sat_depth.window: every recorded physics state, initial included
cylinder.sat_depth.definition: max SAT overlap of cylinder prism against either pad box
cylinder.sat_depth.approximation: Declared polygonal prism, not ideal cylinder; sections/faceting remain in receipt
cylinder.sat_depth.description_zh: 离散棱柱与两指盒的 SAT 重叠最大值；不是理想圆柱，边数及离散误差见原始配置

contact.momentum.definition: max norm(mass*delta_velocity/dt - contact - external + gravity) / weight
contact.momentum.approximation: Net native force on tested body at declared step epoch, not contact command
contact.momentum.description_zh: 被测刚体逐步动量残差最大值除以重力；使用原生合力及声明时序，不是指令值

normal.static_error.approximation: Synthetic 20 kN/m target; 2/6 N fit and 4 N validation; not hardware accuracy
normal.static_error.description_zh: 2/4/6 N 平台末 50 ms 压入均值相对 20 kN/m 合成目标的最大相对误差；不是硬件精度

normal.plateau_std.window: last 50 ms of each positive-load plateau
normal.plateau_std.definition: maximum population standard deviation among 2,4,6 N plateaus
normal.plateau_std.approximation: Mean removed only; slow drift remains; not detrended jitter
normal.plateau_std.description_zh: 三个正载荷平台末 50 ms 的总体标准差最大值；仅去均值，仍包含慢漂移

normal.transient_rms.window: first 50 ms after t=0,0.2,0.4; onset excluded
normal.transient_rms.definition: maximum per-window RMS error against m*xdd+40*xd+20000*x=load
normal.transient_rms.approximation: Exact underdamped synthetic response; no offset/time fit; excludes detachment
normal.transient_rms.description_zh: 各加载起点后 50 ms 对合成阻尼弹簧响应的最大窗口 RMS 误差；不拟合时移或偏置，不含脱离阶段

normal.transient_peak.window: first 50 ms after t=0,0.2,0.4; onset excluded
normal.transient_peak.definition: maximum absolute error across the three transient windows
normal.transient_peak.approximation: Same synthetic reference as transient_rms; not fitted material dynamics
normal.transient_peak.description_zh: 三个瞬态窗口的最大绝对误差；与 RMS 使用同一合成参考，不是材料动力学实测

material_slip.frame: persistent paired material points projected on contact tangent
material_slip.definition: cumulative relative tangential material displacement would be required
material_slip.approximation: No persistent material-pair record exists; value must be null, never zero
material_slip.description_zh: 缺少持久接触材料点对应与切向轨迹；必须记为 null，不能用零或腕部漂移替代
